title: Protective Plate
summary: AC 18 Heavy Armour with Necrotic resistance and no Stealth penalty.

fields.Protection: Resistance to Necrotic damage. Wearing this plate does not impose disadvantage on Stealth checks.
fields.Acquisition: Loot Hollow Armour at the bottom of the pit in the House of Healing Morgue.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
